# GitHub Copilot — read AGENTS.md

All agent-facing coding instructions for this repository live in **AGENTS.md** at the
repository root. Read that file first and follow it exactly: it covers the package layout,
the layering rules (core → arch/commands → bootstrap), the `current_arch` rule, how to add
a command or an architecture, how to run the test matrix, and the superpowers-based
development workflow this project uses.
